focus: Static source/test review of StudioView repairSelection, replace, undo, redo, confirmed deletion and duplication against docs/DESIGN.md live-UUID selection policy. Async project adoption and Plan marker semantics excluded.

checks.result: replace validates before changing scene, ignores no-op replacements, records prior scene, then repairs selection. Undo and redo restore scene content and repair selection without restoring historical selection. A surviving selected UUID remains unchanged; an absent UUID falls back to first remaining light; an empty rig clears it.

Confirmed deletion removes only the captured target UUID from the current scene, and its captured generation is checked. It routes through replace/repairSelection, so undoing deletion cannot steal another surviving selection. Duplicate requires a live original and available capacity, assigns a new UUID, preserves equipment geometry, replaces the scene, and selects that inserted UUID. The only inspected duplicate caller uses sceneAction generation validation. Equipment-list selection additionally checks the UUID still exists.

Selection/lifecycle boundaries close pending edit transactions. Discrete record closes a continuous edit before recording the new command. History stores scene snapshots only, consistent with current-selection policy. Owner-qualified late end callbacks cannot close a newer edit belonging to another owner.

Reviewed tests for coalesced edits, unchanged/cancelled edits preserving redo, discrete commands during gestures preserving independent undo steps, limits/reset, delayed owner callbacks and cross-control edits. These are source assertions, not executed results.

Recipe/add workflow asserts the newly added row is selected; guide workflow asserts the selected Key survives modal navigation with both history directions retained and then exercises history content transitions. Camera workflow asserts undo/redo restores focal length. These are source assertions, not executed results.

limitations: Host unavailable. No shell commands, agent_cycle check/next, Swift tests, build, simulator, UI test or screenshot review executed.
Review used actual GitHub fetch_file responses at the pinned base SHA; local working-tree status, branch/recent commits and runtime CI outcomes were not independently inspected in this worker.

The two assigned test files do not directly assert selection fallback after selected-light deletion, empty-rig selection clearing, retained selection after undo-restoring a deleted light, or duplicate undo/redo selection. This is limited test-source coverage observation, not a demonstrated product defect or a claim about unreviewed test suites.
Async project adoption and Plan marker semantics intentionally excluded.
No source files, tree objects, commits or refs changed. This report is uploaded only as an unreferenced JSON blob.
conclusion: No reproducible must-fix source defect found within the assigned live-UUID selection and edit-history scope. Implementation inspected is consistent with the written policy; runtime behavior remains unverified.
